title: Dispatch versioned HTTP exchange controllers
summary: Versioned HTTP exchange controllers now dispatch to v1.1 on MVC and WebFlux. Both stacks rejected version 99 with HTTP 400 and zero controller invocations.

change.description: MVC and WebFlux now transfer the version declared on an HTTP exchange annotation to the server-side request mapping.

notes: MockMvc and WebTestClient used the same published Spring Test 7.0.10 client companion with both original server revisions. Standard request mappings provided the control.
